implementation.authenticity_section7: Actual CanvasRenderingContext2D class owns the native backing store and protected constructor; operations validate private receiver brands. getImageData rejects zero extents and normalizes negative rectangles; measureText is independent of paint. AudioBuffer bounds/copies and scheduled starts preserve real DSP. Canvas/Audio/GL do not manufacture native-code source. Shared renderer now resolves generic families from actual allowed proportional/monospace faces; no public native bridge added.
implementation.software_declarations: One stable userAgentData object per Window/Worker reads private current host inputs; Worker installs it once, excluding the serialized declaration from generic descriptors. Configured UA product/version and resolved platform drive actual HTTP hints. Honest native fallback is Obscura/0.1.0; unknown high-entropy values remain empty. Explicit persisted UAs and nonempty generator versions remain supported.
implementation.realm_canvas_ownership: Canvas registration and damage use the active native frame owner, never root DOM fallback for retired children. GL contexts are keyed by (frame_id,node_id), preventing root/child arena collisions. The private realm identifier is supplied by the original closure and cannot be overridden by request extras. Hidden frames retain actual native drawing surfaces.
implementation.audio_receiver_ownership: Vendored API implementation/context fields are migrated to closure-owned WeakMaps with captured intrinsic accessors; no exported raw _impl objects or writable replacement DSP state. Float32Array checks use the intrinsic typed-array brand across realms. Destination disconnect overloads unwrap genuine records, validate ports/context/connections and remove actual graph edges. Real AudioContext catch-up rechecks running state and sample-clock progress after callbacks, including synchronous suspend/close.
implementation.classic_worker_imports: Synchronous importScripts runs in the original Worker V8 context through a reentrant native op and the existing fetch_url_inner transport/security pipeline, including configured proxy, cookies, origin, SSRF/redirect/blocked-URL gates, interception and body limits. URLs are parsed before execution, relative imports use the final entry URL, JavaScript MIME/status are validated, original compile/runtime exceptions propagate, and termination cancels pending loading. No alternate fetch stack or eval shim.
implementation.worker_reactor_cost: One additional persistent I/O reactor thread per live dedicated Worker. Deno async ops retain their required current-thread reactor. Synchronous imports poll the non-Send shared fetch future on the original V8/Rc owning thread under a temporary I/O handle; that handle is left before author compilation/execution. Transport DNS/blocking-pool use remains workload-dependent.
implementation.baseline_client_hints: Root and isolated BrowserContext HTTP clients retain the explicit resolved native platform. One native header generator supplies navigation and scripted Fetch/Worker/import request assembly, including redirect hops, so a native non-Mozilla UA does not produce an empty platform or missing baseline hints.
implementation.canonical_hashes: Resolved and render object digests use one in-place recursive key-sorting helper before compact UTF8 serialization, independent of serde_json preserve_order. Original environment file SHA256 still hashes unmodified bytes. Added nested/order/UTF8 regression, not run.
implementation.native_control_text: Document cosmic-text/Swash font selection, shaping and clipping for native control values/placeholders/password masks/select labels; actual shaped intrinsic advances and line metrics for buttons/columns, no embedded control bitmap-text path
implementation.frame_surface_hook: Runtime screenshots recursively composite actual authoritative child SharedState rasters through CanvasSurfaceSource using content dimensions, native scroll/clipping/stacking and child resources; no second browser/DOM/network execution; detached resource tasks abort and capture-local surfaces cannot become stale
implementation.surface_dpr_alpha: Shared surface paint applies actual raster scale once to CSS destination and rounded clip, retaining device-space ancestor masks/culling; native child captures start transparent and borrow premultiplied RGBA without redundant conversion/copy. Added fractional/high-DPR, crop/clip, transparency/live-mutation regressions, unrun; bad7017PNG preserved and no GUI pass inferred.
implementation.frame_protocol: Actual loaded child node.frameId/contentDocument.frameId, native default execution context publication and exact selected-realm evaluation/call routing; generation-bound child DOM IDs cannot alias main arena; real transformed/scrolled content/padding/border/margin quads replace synthetic geometry; actual in-flight Document loads use existing navigation deadline
implementation.private_identity: Native-owned locale/resolved inputs cached via a separate host-retained closure bridge; frozen Deno.core is unmodified. Focused element is realm-private closure state. No public environment/language/focus state assignment/copy/read; getter names and function-source presentation unchanged
implementation.worker_fetch_cache: Request cache modes inherit/override explicitly; unsupported modes reject; real no-store transport reaches the network over redirects. Parent ran the cacheable-resource real-transport regression successfully.
implementation.durability: Cookie write guards, LocalStorage write-through snapshot, IndexedDB commit-time synced atomic files; startup restores before READY; Cookie/LocalStorage I/O failure aborts runtime fail-closed
implementation.remote_objects: Private per-runtime v8::Global roots with CSPRNG opaque IDs bound to original realm/document generation; no page-global registry or expression recipes; native descriptors, console, object arguments and DOM resolution share roots; release drops roots and replaced realms report stale_reference
implementation.parent_shutdown: A native stdin reader thread signals actual server shutdown on parent EOF; startup checks before/after READY, processors stop, connections drain and storage flushes; standalone behavior is unchanged without env flag; no PID polling or subprocess watchdog
implementation.gl_followups: Real driver-backed resource is* queries and SUBPIXEL_BITS; concrete resource-owning WebGL classes with private owner/type/lifetime records, deferred Shader/Program deletion and uniform generation checks; actual errors/compiler logs, no brand/toString relabeling; existing precision/vector/pixel transfer/resize support
implementation.interaction_css: Authoritative connected-node focus/active/hover state; composed shadow-host ancestry for focus-within/active/hover; separate actual focus-visible policy; native focus/blur and pointer/modality events invalidate style/layout; disconnect clears state. New DOM and native runtime regressions written but not run.
implementation.target_activation: Page.bringToFront and Target.activateTarget select existing native registry targets, update actual foreground focus/visibility and dispatch lifecycle events; persistent Page state seeds new/resumed runtimes before scripts; live heaps/contexts/session routes/remote handles are preserved. Activation callbacks use existing command watchdog.
implementation.private_event_boundary: Closure-owned Event brand and immutable isTrusted use captured WeakSet methods. Native constructors/dispatch and document capabilities live in private V8 handles, inaccessible to author globals/lexicals. Real first-HTTP-author and Worker regressions passed, including replaced constructors and post-dispatch trust clearing. Worker global event methods resolve null/undefined receivers to the real global.
implementation.native_focus_ownership: Page-shared native focused (frame_id,node_id,document_generation) tuple records actual connected DOM focus, inherits into child realms and clears direct/ancestor-retired owners without reborrowing a held DOM; original captured focus/blur and exact native document members are private callbacks.
implementation.native_viewer_input: Authoritative child hit testing, native frame/node/generation focus and private captured document methods; uncancelled Meta+A/UTF16 and Tab/Shift+Tab defaults. Six CDP input regressions passed. Final actual DPR2 GUI verifies Chinese replacement, Tab focus, counter and original child click; no physical IME claim.
